name: MyBotify
author: ThemeParrot

sections.description:
Stop worrying about losing customers and sending manual emails for abandoned carts. Instead of relying on emails with low open rates (5% to 20%), switch to MyBotify’s WooCommerce plugin and send WhatsApp messages for abandoned cart recovery and transactional alerts – achieving 90%+ open rates.

Install MyBotify’s WooCommerce plugin for free – no coding required!

How It Works

The plugin captures the customer’s phone number at checkout and saves the cart in real time.

If a cart is abandoned, MyBotify automatically sends a WhatsApp message with a direct link to restore the cart and complete the purchase.

Features

🚀 Abandoned Cart Recovery – Automatically send WhatsApp reminders to customers who leave items in their cart.

📦 Order & Shipping Alerts – Notify customers about order confirmations, shipping updates, and more via WhatsApp.

📊 Advanced Analytics – Track the performance of your messages with detailed insights on read rates and engagement.

📌 Pre-Designed Message Templates – Save time with ready-to-use WhatsApp templates – just customize and send!

⏳ Customizable Trigger Times (Coming Soon) – A feature to set custom time delays for message delivery, such as sending reminders 5 minutes after checkout abandonment.

About MyBotify.com

MyBotify is a cutting-edge WhatsApp automation platform powered by Humbletree. As an all-in-one solution, MyBotify enables businesses and individuals to streamline WhatsApp communication with advanced chatbot automation, seamless integrations, and secure payment processing.

With MyBotify, you can build a WhatsApp chatbot without coding using an intuitive drag-and-drop chatbot builder or set up keyword-based automation to enhance customer interactions.

To learn more about MyBotify, [visit the official website] (https://whatsapp.mybotify.com/).

What the service is and what it is used for

  • MyBotify API: Facilitates WhatsApp messaging, and real-time order updates for WooCommerce.
  • MyBotify Integration API: Verifies API keys and authenticates domain configurations for secure plugin operation.

What data is sent and when

  • When WooCommerce order notifications are enabled, order details (such as order status, total amount, and customer contact number) are transmitted to MyBotify for WhatsApp notifications.
  • During plugin setup and authentication, the API key and website domain are sent to the MyBotify Integration API for verification.
  • No sensitive payment details or personally identifiable information are stored by MyBotify, but external service providers may log requests for security and performance monitoring.

Service Provider

Provider: MyBotify (powered by Humbletree)
– Terms of Use: [https://whatsapp.mybotify.com/terms-and-conditions]
– Privacy Policy: [https://whatsapp.mybotify.com/privacy-policy]

Support

For support, visit Whatsapp.MyBotify.com or the WordPress support forum.
sections.installation:
Download and install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the ZIP file via the Plugins > Add New section in your WordPress dashboard.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Navigate to WooCommerce > MyBotify. To configure your MyBotify API and message settings.

Connect your WhatsApp Business API and start recovering abandoned carts!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a WhatsApp Business API?

Yes, MyBotify requires a WhatsApp Business API account. If you don’t have one, follow our setup guide in the plugin settings.

How can I apply for WhatsApp Official API?

To integrate MyBotify with WhatsApp’s official API, you’ll need:

A WhatsApp Phone Number – Should not have an existing WhatsApp account.

Business Display Name – Must reflect a clear connection with your brand.

Verified Facebook Business Manager ID – Your business must be verified with official documents. [Create an account] (https://business.facebook.com/).

MyBotify team will assist you to complete all registration.

Is MyBotify free?

Yes, the plugin is free to install and use. However, WhatsApp Business API usage may have costs depending on your provider.
